recommendations.title: Buy Cleveland Cavaliers -4.5
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Cleveland Cavaliers -4.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 49% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 53%. Priced at -105, that works out to roughly +4.3% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.
